name: Alex
bio: Records weekly explainer videos from a converted home office. Cares about consistent skin tones across sessions more than absolute resolution.

name: Florence
bio: Hosts live panel events on YouTube and LinkedIn Live. Switched to ATEM Extreme ISO G2 after one too many OBS crashes mid-stream.

name: Sam
bio: Runs a 3-host video podcast with rotating guests. Spent 18 months over-investing in cameras before realizing the audio chain was the actual problem.

name: Travel Kit
bio: OHG's recommended kit for panelists on the road. Everything in this build packs into a single carry-on with room left for clothes.

name: Marcus
bio: Streams a weekly community show from his living room. Proves that $500 done right beats $3,000 done sloppy — audio first, lighting second, camera third.

name: OHG HQ
bio: The reference studio at OHG HQ. NDI route with three BirdDog PTZ cameras, X32 audio, vMix Pro. Used for live conference programming and panelist drop-ins.
